title: Maximum features
details:
Thank you for subscribing to Euforia MAX.
Let's see what's unlocked for you now:

items.title: Loving Voice Therapy®
items.text: Unlimited access to daily audio sessions designed to support your emotional well-being and recovery.

items.title: Voice Avatars
items.text: Personalize your audio session experience by adding your favorite photos.

items.title: Soundscapes
items.text: Full library of soundscapes and sounds. Customize your scenes and immerse yourself in calming and relaxing atmospheres.

items.title: Meditations
items.text: All meditations and Euforia Programs are now fully unlocked for you.

items.title: Articles
items.text: Read all Euforia articles and explore a wide range of text content.

items.title: Exercises
items.text: Access a variety of yoga exercises and start practicing today.

items.title: Offline access
items.text: Download meditations, articles, scenes, and exercises for offline use.

items.title: No Ads & Restrictions
items.text: No more ads, banners, and locked features. Enjoy Euforia without any interruptions.

items.title: Updates & Priority
items.text: Enjoy early updates and priority support whenever you need it.

bottomCardText: Euforia MAX is a paid option that grants you access to all of Euforia's features and ensures continuous content updates. For subscribers, we utilize advanced data centers, provide enhanced support, and deliver unique solutions. Your subscription empowers us to create new audio sessions, and other content, offer technical support, and take our services to the next level. We appreciate your contribution.
